guide.title: EPR spec – plaster finish to ceilings

tight, matt, smooth – no hollows, trowel marks or crazing
set in a depression, paper not broken, filled flush
continuous acrylic sealant bead, no gaps
guide.note: The EPR spec is tighter than the trade ITP (MEA: 2 mm per run up to 8 m). The spec governs.

notOk.t: Primary channel cantilever over 450 mm (700 mm recorded – extra hanger needed)
Ceiling tracks cut for downlights without trimming
Access panels not flush, gaps uneven, frame bowed, cracks at corners
Steps at light coves / shadow gaps uneven
Poor cutting in, marks on ceiling
Fire stopping or dampers boxed in with no access
Grilles not parallel to walls / units
